text.arabic_uthmani: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا نُوحًا إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ فَلَبِثَ فِيهِمْ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍ إِلَّا خَمْسِينَ عَامًۭا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱلطُّوفَانُ وَهُمْ ظَٰلِمُونَ

words.gloss_range: opening connector that both resumes the previous warning and launches an emphatic Noah narrative
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) opens the ayah as a bonded discourse hinge. It carries the Noah report forward from the prior warning while helping form a solemn mission-launch formula, so the story reads as historical verification rather than an isolated anecdote. The repeated formula evidence keeps the opening tied to prophetic dispatch scenes (7:59; 11:25; 23:23; 71:1).

topics.headline: continuation into historical proof
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the Noah narrative is attached to the previous warning as proof, not introduced as a detached story.
topics.reason: The initial connector is licensed as coordination or resumption and the CRITICAL rows tie that boundary to the prior discourse.

topics.headline: bonded emphatic launch formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the first word contribute to a solemn prophetic-mission launch before the first content noun appears.
topics.reason: The word is graphically bound to the following emphatic opening and the rows identify the recurrent mission-launch pattern.

words.gloss_range: emphatic prefix bound to the certainty particle, making the report solemn and assertional
words.prose: {{ar:لَ}} ({{tr:la}}) is not a free-standing content word; it is the prefixed emphasis that tightens the following certainty particle. Before the sending verb appears, the listener is already placed inside a solemn assertion rather than a casual historical report.

topics.headline: prefixed oath-like emphasis before the verb
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that emphasis arrives before the action itself, calibrating the report as certified testimony.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the particle as an emphatic prefix attached to the certainty particle, and the CRITICAL rows consistently read it as stacked emphasis.

words.gloss_range: certainty particle before a perfect verb, locally selecting verified completed action rather than approximation
words.prose: {{ar:قَدْ}} ({{tr:qad}}) keeps its own particle force even after the prefixed emphasis. Because it stands before a perfect verb, its range is narrowed to verification of a completed sending, so the past event is presented as proof, not possibility or approximation.

topics.headline: perfect verb selects completed-certainty force
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the sending framed as an established fact, while the particle range is limited by the following perfect verb.
topics.reason: The following perfect verb blocks approximation readings and selects the completed-certainty value.

topics.headline: distinct certainty unit inside stacked emphasis
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the opener stacks distinguishable emphasis mechanisms rather than using one vague intensifier.
topics.reason: The written form preserves the certainty particle as a separate unit while the surrounding construction supplies double declarative emphasis.

topics.headline: past intervention verifies the warning
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the move from future accountability to a verified past example that functions as proof.
topics.reason: The boundary row coherently links the particle’s verification to the ayah’s shift into past prophetic history.

words.gloss_range: completed causative divine dispatch of Noah toward a defined mission audience
words.root_gloss_range: release, sending, dispatch, and message-bearing; locally Form IV selects causative commissioned sending by the divine speaker
words.prose: {{ar:أَرْسَلْنَا}} ({{tr:arsalnā}}) gathers divine agency, completed action, and commissioned dispatch into one verb. Its Form IV shape makes Noah sent by a causal sender, while the root range behind {{ar:ر س ل}} ({{tr:r-s-l}}) leaves a useful release-versus-commission tension: he is sent outward, but not aimlessly. The formula of sending a prophet to his people is part of a wider mission pattern (7:59; 11:25; 23:23), and this first narrative beat later divides into seizure and salvation (29:15).

topics.headline: divine completed agency in Form IV dispatch
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Noah does not simply go; the verb encodes God as the completed causal sender.
topics.reason: The perfect Form IV verb with first-plural suffix supplies divine agency and causative dispatch toward the prepositional destination.

topics.headline: release image governed by commission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the root’s release image, while local Form IV grammar keeps that release governed by divine mission rather than loose wandering.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is coherent, but the local form and complements select commissioned sending as the active sense.

topics.headline: prophet-to-people dispatch formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the verse as a type-scene of prophetic commissioning, not merely a biographical note about Noah.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows give a concrete repeated formula, and the local verb plus proper-name object plus destination phrase match it.

topics.headline: first beat of mission-duration-consequence arc
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah as a three-beat movement: divine initiative, long duration, then consequence with salvation contrasted next (29:15).
topics.reason: The attachment evidence divides the ayah into sending, remaining, seizure, and state clauses, matching the CRITICAL narrative-frame rows.

words.gloss_range: foreign proper name in accusative object position, with only cautious name-resonance pressure
words.prose: {{ar:نُوحًا}} ({{tr:nūḥan}}) identifies the specific prophet as the one sent, not the sender or destination. The accusative form makes the proper name participate in the object slot after the dispatch verb. Rows that connect the name with lamentation are useful as narrowed resonance only; QAC treats the local word as a foreign proper noun, so the grief pressure cannot become a local lexical root claim. The name also begins the surah’s prophet-to-community chain, later mirrored by another prophet-to-people scene (29:28).

topics.headline: specific prophet as dispatched object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Noah as the patient of divine sending, fixed by case as the dispatched individual.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the accusative proper name as the direct object of the sending verb.

topics.headline: lamentation pressure without replacing proper-name status
topics.reader_payoff: The reader may hear grief and persistence around the named prophet, while the local grammar still treats the word as a proper name.
topics.reason: The supplied name-resonance rows are meaningful, but QAC gives no local lexical root for the foreign proper noun.

topics.headline: named exemplar in a prophet-community sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader recognizes Noah as an archetypal sent warner whose pairing with a community opens a repeated surah pattern.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows tie the proper name to recurring dispatch contexts and to a later prophet-to-people scene in the same surah.

words.gloss_range: directional preposition that turns sending into mission toward a defined audience
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَىٰ}} ({{tr:ilā}}) supplies the direction slot of the dispatch frame. It turns release into targeted mission: Noah is sent toward a particular community, and the first clause does not close until that destination has been named.

topics.headline: mission movement toward a defined endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the sending has an endpoint and purpose, not just outward motion.
topics.reason: The preposition governs the following people-word as the destination complement of the sending verb.

topics.headline: compact particle completes the first beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees a small particle creating the dependency that completes agent, envoy, and destination before the duration clause begins.
topics.reason: The fixed preposition has no root bulk but creates the syntactic link required by the dispatch frame.

words.gloss_range: Noah’s own community as the genitive destination of the mission, with collective standing pressure retained
words.root_gloss_range: standing, establishing, maintaining, and peoplehood; locally the collective people sense is primary, with upright-standing pressure retained cautiously
words.prose: {{ar:قَوْمِهِۦ}} ({{tr:qawmihī}}) is not an abstract population; the construct plus suffix makes the people Noah’s own community and the endpoint of the sending. The root range in {{ar:ق و م}} ({{tr:q-w-m}}) can press standing and established order into the background, so the later wrongdoer label becomes a contradiction of what a people should be. The word also becomes the local node where prophetic dispatch and communal moral failure meet, opening the surah’s chain of tested communities. Still, local grammar selects a collective community noun, not an independent act of standing.

topics.headline: his people as mission endpoint
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both belonging and destination: Noah is sent to his own people, not to an anonymous audience.
topics.reason: The genitive noun is governed by the preposition and carries a third-person suffix referring to Noah.

topics.headline: standing image behind collective peoplehood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the irony that a community associated with standing and order is later characterized by moral displacement.
topics.reason: The root-family pressure is useful, while local noun grammar keeps the selected sense as collective peoplehood.

topics.headline: people as node between mission and judgment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees this community as the place where prophetic dispatch and moral accountability meet.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the people-word with mission, later wrongdoing, and same-surah community scenes without contradicting local grammar.

words.gloss_range: first sequential connector, moving from divine dispatch into Noah’s long remaining
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) makes the remaining follow the sending as the next narrative turn. The first connector does more than place two clauses side by side: it pivots from divine initiative to Noah’s sustained presence, preparing the second connector that will move from duration to seizure.

topics.headline: sending immediately turns into remaining
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the mission become long-duration presence through a tight sequential turn.
topics.reason: The connector links the remaining verb to the sending clause in a strongly licensed sequence.

topics.headline: first of two narrative hinges
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the ayah’s chain as sending to remaining to seizure, rather than as three loose events.
topics.reason: The first connector is structurally paired with the later connector before the seizure clause.

words.gloss_range: intransitive remaining or tarrying by Noah, embedded among the people for an extraordinary duration
words.root_gloss_range: remaining, tarrying, staying, and lingering; locally the intransitive verb selects prolonged remaining within a community
words.prose: {{ar:لَبِثَ}} ({{tr:labitha}}) slows the narrative into the ayah’s middle beat. The verb is intransitive and takes a locative complement, so Noah’s mission is not described as a quick visit but as remaining among the people. The root range in {{ar:ل ب ث}} ({{tr:l-b-th}}) strengthens duration and non-departure, and the cave-sleepers parallel shows the verb’s association with extraordinary time (18:12).

topics.headline: intransitive remaining with locative complement
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices Noah’s mission as embedded presence among the people, not an external action done to an object.
topics.reason: The verb has no direct object and is completed by the locative phrase and duration measure.

topics.headline: prolonged tarrying governs the duration beat
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the 950-year phrase as intensifying the verb’s own duration field rather than as a flat calendar add-on.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows and contextual profile support prolonged remaining, with a concrete long-duration parallel at 18:12.

words.gloss_range: locative phrase placing Noah within the same community that remains in view through seizure and judgment
words.prose: {{ar:فِيهِمْ}} ({{tr:fīhim}}) anchors the remaining inside the people. After direction toward them, this phrase shifts the scene to being within them, and the attached plural pronoun keeps the same community present until they become the object of seizure and the subject of the final moral state.

topics.headline: locative containment of the mission
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Noah’s endurance occurs within the community’s social space, not outside it.
topics.reason: The preposition and pronoun form the locative complement required by the remaining verb.

topics.headline: same community carried by the pronoun
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks one community from mission destination to embedded audience to seized wrongdoers.
topics.reason: The pronoun resolves to Noah’s people and recurs through the later object and moral-state frame.

words.gloss_range: a bounded thousand used as the temporal measure for remaining, later narrowed by exception
words.root_gloss_range: thousand-counting and familiarity or social bonding in the root family; locally the number sense is selected, with familiarity only as narrowed resonance
words.prose: {{ar:أَلْفَ}} ({{tr:alfa}}) measures the time of remaining rather than an object acted upon. Its accusative role makes the thousand the temporal field of the verb, and its bounded roundness gives the exception a stable base to subtract from. The root range in {{ar:أ ل ف}} ({{tr:ʾ-l-f}}) also permits a narrowed familiarity resonance, fitting a long embedded mission, but the local selected sense remains the number.

topics.headline: thousand as duration measure, not object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the number measures the span of Noah’s remaining rather than naming something he acts upon.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the number an adverbial duration dependent on the remaining verb.

topics.headline: bounded thousand makes near-millennium rhetoric possible
topics.reader_payoff: The reader first feels a full millennium before the exception revises it downward to 950.
topics.reason: The singular accusative number supplies the bounded total that the exception particle can subtract from.

topics.headline: familiarity resonance under the number sense
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense social familiarity and long companionship around the thousand, while grammar keeps the word as a count.
topics.reason: The root-family resonance is plausible but subordinate to the local noun-of-number role.

words.gloss_range: singular genitive year-unit for the thousand, with hardship, recurrence, and precedent pressure retained cautiously
words.root_gloss_range: year, established way, precedent, sharpening, and recurring pattern; locally the counted year unit is selected, with hardship and precedent pressure retained cautiously
words.prose: {{ar:سَنَةٍ}} ({{tr:sanatin}}) supplies the counted unit for the thousand in the grammar of large numbers. Its root range {{ar:س ن ن}} ({{tr:s-n-n}}) allows pressure from recurring pattern, established way, and even hard years, so the main span can feel heavy and precedent-setting. The contrast with the later year-word matters, but this local word remains the genitive specification of the thousand.

topics.headline: genitive singular unit after the thousand
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the vast number grammatically tied to a singular year-unit, not left as an abstract magnitude.
topics.reason: The noun is the genitive specification for the thousand according to local number syntax.

topics.headline: large span uses one year-word before the exception switches terms
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices lexical variation inside the arithmetic phrase: the main span and the subtracted span are not named with identical year-words.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows identify a local contrast between the year-word used with the thousand and the one used with the fifty.

topics.headline: root pressure makes the years feel recurrent and precedent-setting
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can feel the years as repeated, established endurance, while the selected local sense remains a counted year unit.
topics.reason: The root-family rows are meaningful but must be limited by the noun’s local tamyiz role.

words.gloss_range: exception particle that subtracts fifty from the thousand and makes the duration read as a near-millennium
words.prose: {{ar:إِلَّا}} ({{tr:illā}}) is the hinge that turns a thousand-year frame into a computed near-millennium. It scopes over the fifty-year exception, so the reader must keep the full thousand in memory while subtracting the smaller amount. The result is not a flat 950 but a rhetorically preserved thousand minus fifty.

topics.headline: exception particle performs exact subtraction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader performs the duration as 1000 minus 50, rather than receiving 950 as a flat statistic.
topics.reason: The exception particle governs the subtracted number and restricts the initial duration claim exactly.

topics.headline: exception preserves the thousand while narrowing it
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the mission as almost a full millennium, with the exception intensifying rather than weakening the duration.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows converge on subtraction, near-completion, and year-word variation as one rhetorical duration frame.

words.gloss_range: exact accusative fifty as the excepted amount, measured against the thousand
words.root_gloss_range: five, fifth, and measured portions; locally the tens-number fifty is selected as the exact excepted amount
words.prose: {{ar:خَمْسِينَ}} ({{tr:khamsīna}}) names the exact amount removed by the exception. Its case makes it dependent on the subtraction construction, and its counted-unit phrase prevents the fifty from becoming vague or merely symbolic. Against a thousand, the number functions as a small measured offset, making the mission almost fill the round total.

topics.headline: accusative fifty in the exception construction
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices fifty as the grammatically exact exception, not a second independent duration.
topics.reason: The number is accusative as the excepted element and is completed by its counted specification.

topics.headline: measured five-percent offset against a millennium
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the subtraction as a small measured portion removed from a full thousand, sharpening the near-millennium effect.
topics.reason: The fractional root pressure is useful as measure-language, while local grammar selects the exact tens-number fifty.

words.gloss_range: accusative year-unit for the subtracted fifty, lexically distinct from the thousand-year unit and carrying only narrowed water-motion undertone
words.root_gloss_range: year and a homographic swim/float field; locally the year unit is selected, with water-motion pressure only as a narrowed undertone before the flood
words.prose: {{ar:عَامًۭا}} ({{tr:ʿāman}}) completes the fifty as years, but it does so with a different year-word and case from the thousand’s unit. The root range {{ar:ع و م}} ({{tr:ʿ-w-m}}) lets the word carry a narrowed swim-or-float undertone before the flood appears, yet local grammar keeps the selected sense as the year unit for the exception.

topics.headline: accusative unit completing the fifty
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the subtracted fifty made exact by its own year-unit rather than left as a bare number.
topics.reason: The noun is the accusative specification for the excepted number.

topics.headline: lexical switch from the thousand’s year-word
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the main span and the subtracted span use different year-words, making the arithmetic phrase lexically marked.
topics.reason: The local duration phrase itself supplies the contrast between the two year terms.

topics.headline: homographic float pressure before the flood
topics.reader_payoff: The reader can sense a faint water-motion pressure just before the flood, without replacing the word’s local time meaning.
topics.reason: The homographic swim-or-float field is only an undertone; the accusative tamyiz role selects year as the local sense.

words.gloss_range: second connector, now consequential, moving from the long duration into the seizure event
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) closes the long middle beat and turns it into consequence. This second connector is tighter and heavier than the first: after the near-millennium of remaining, the seizure clause arrives as the result, while its parallel shape recalls the earlier sequence connector and anticipates the next ayah’s salvation turn (29:15).

topics.headline: duration turns into punishment consequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the flood’s seizure is framed as consequence after the long duration, not as an unrelated next scene.
topics.reason: The connector links the seizure clause to the duration clause as a result sequence.

topics.headline: second hinge mirrors the first connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader tracks the repeated connector pattern: sending leads to remaining, and remaining leads to seizure.
topics.reason: The two connector-plus-perfect constructions create a visible intra-ayah chain.

topics.headline: punishment connector anticipates salvation connector
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is prepared for the next ayah’s answering movement from punishment to rescue (29:15).
topics.reason: The boundary row coherently reads this connector as setting up the next ayah’s parallel salvation turn.

words.gloss_range: completed punitive seizure of the same people, with the object attached before the delayed flood-agent appears
words.root_gloss_range: taking, grasping, receiving, and taking-to-task; locally the flood context and moral clause select punitive seizure
words.prose: {{ar:أَخَذَهُمُ}} ({{tr:akhadhahumu}}) attaches the people to the act of seizure before naming the flood as agent. The root range {{ar:أ خ ذ}} ({{tr:ʾ-kh-dh}}) includes taking and grasping, and the local flood subject plus wrongdoer state narrows it to punitive seizure. The word order makes impact arrive first, then agent. Across the boundary from the prior burden-bearing warning, agency reverses: wrongdoers are no longer carrying but being taken. The same seizure formula belongs to a wider punishment pattern (7:78; 29:37; 29:40), and this ayah later contrasts with rescue in the next verse (29:15).

topics.headline: attached object marks the seized community
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the mission audience carried forward as the seized object without being renamed.
topics.reason: The attached object pronoun is the direct object of the perfect verb and resolves to Noah’s people.

topics.headline: taking becomes punitive seizure in context
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the flood’s action as forceful capture and taking-to-task, while local context selects punishment rather than neutral taking.
topics.reason: The flood as subject and the circumstantial wrongdoer clause narrow the root’s broad taking field to punitive seizure.

topics.headline: verb-object-subject order delays the agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader experiences the people as seized before the flood is named as the grammatical actor.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the flood as delayed subject after the verb and object suffix.

topics.headline: seizure root enters the surah’s consequence network
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees active burden-bearing from the prior warning reverse into wrongdoers being involuntarily taken, with the seizure generalized later (29:40).
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect this seizure with the surah’s punishment sequence and the preceding boundary contrast.

words.gloss_range: the known overwhelming flood-calamity as delayed nominative subject and catastrophe-agent
words.root_gloss_range: going around, encircling, visitation, and overwhelming calamity; locally the intensive disaster noun functions as the delayed subject that seizes
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلطُّوفَانُ}} ({{tr:al-ṭūfānu}}) finally names the delayed agent that has already seized the people. As a definite nominative subject, it is the known catastrophe acting in the clause. The root range {{ar:ط و ف}} ({{tr:ṭ-w-f}}) brings circling and encircling pressure, while the intensive form makes the calamity feel encompassing rather than merely a quantity of water. The broader calamity range is supported by the other occurrence in the plague context (7:133), but locally the Noah scene selects the overwhelming flood-agent.

topics.headline: known catastrophe-agent named after the object
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the people are seized before the known flood-agent is named.
topics.reason: The noun is nominative subject of the seizure verb and appears after the attached object.

topics.headline: circling root and intensive form create engulfment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels the flood as an encompassing catastrophe that surrounds and overwhelms, while the local scene keeps it as the disaster-agent of seizure.
topics.reason: The root and form rows support circling and intensive engulfment, but local grammar selects the definite disaster subject.

topics.headline: plague occurrence broadens the semantic range
topics.reader_payoff: The reader avoids reducing the term to water volume alone; the word can mark overwhelming calamity, though this local story selects the flood-agent.
topics.reason: The concrete comparison at 7:133 supports a broader calamity range, while local subject role keeps the Noah flood as the selected referent.

words.gloss_range: circumstantial connector introducing the people’s state at the moment of seizure
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) introduces the final clause as circumstance, not a separate added event. The connector ties the seizure to the people’s moral state, so the closing judgment describes the condition in which they were taken.

topics.headline: circumstantial connector binds seizure to moral state
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that wrongdoing is the state accompanying the seizure, not an afterthought appended to the story.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the connector as circumstantial and attach the nominal state clause to the seizure event.

words.gloss_range: independent plural pronoun subject of the circumstantial nominal clause, resolving to Noah’s people
words.prose: {{ar:هُمْ}} ({{tr:hum}}) gives the final moral clause its own explicit subject. The pronoun resolves to Noah’s people, not to Noah, and its independent form gives the predicate a stable identification frame rather than a loose adjective or another attached suffix. At the boundary, the plural frame lets Noah’s community be heard within the broader pattern of communities under moral testing.

topics.headline: explicit subject for the moral-state clause
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final judgment has an explicit subject slot, making the moral label stable and direct.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the subject of the nominal circumstantial clause.

topics.headline: pronoun routes blame to the people, not Noah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader keeps the blame attached to the mission audience rather than misreading it as attached to the prophet.
topics.reason: The referent profile and CRITICAL rows resolve the plural pronoun to Noah’s people.

topics.headline: plural frame overlays current and narrated wrongdoers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader hears the Noah community as part of a broader pattern of communities under moral testing.
topics.reason: The boundary row coherently reads the pronoun continuity as linking the story to the surrounding warning frame.

words.gloss_range: active participle predicate naming the seized people as enduring wrongdoers, with displacement and darkness pressure
words.root_gloss_range: wronging, misplacing, injustice, and darkness/obscurity; locally the active participle names the people as enduring wrongdoers
words.prose: {{ar:ظَٰلِمُونَ}} ({{tr:ẓālimūna}}) is the closing predicate, so the ayah ends on moral diagnosis rather than on the flood itself. The active participle makes wrongdoing a characterizing state, and agreement locks it to the people. The root range {{ar:ظ ل م}} ({{tr:ẓ-l-m}}) brings wronging, displacement, and darkness pressure; locally that range explains why the seizure is not arbitrary. The label also joins the surah’s broader wrongdoer pattern, including the next community scene (29:31) and other seizure-while-wrongdoing patterns (7:78; 8:54; 29:40).

topics.headline: closing predicate identifies enduring wrongdoers
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees the final word characterize who they are, not merely report one past act.
topics.reason: The active participle is the predicate of the independent pronoun in the circumstantial nominal clause.

topics.headline: moral displacement with darkness undertone
topics.reader_payoff: The reader feels wrongdoing as disorder and obscurity, while the local participle still names moral wrongdoers.
topics.reason: The root-family rows support displacement and darkness pressure, but local grammar selects the moral active-participle label.

topics.headline: wrongdoer label joins recurring seized-community pattern
topics.reader_payoff: The reader sees Noah’s people as the first local instance of a recurring communal wrongdoing diagnosis.
topics.reason: The CRITICAL rows connect the closing label with later community scenes and seizure-while-wrongdoing formulas.

topics.headline: wrongdoer closure sets up rescue and classifies prior fabrication
topics.reader_payoff: The reader is prepared for rescue to separate Noah from the seized wrongdoers and for prior false promise to be folded into wrongdoing.
topics.reason: The boundary rows link the final moral label backward to fabrication and forward to the following rescue contrast.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 2, 5, and 6: the commission, its human destination, and the stay within that collective.
baseline_models.mechanism: The act of sending establishes a communicative office, but the following locative stay prevents the office from reading as a brief delivery. The messenger remains embedded in the same social body to which he was directed.

activation_trace.role: The messenger-and-message sense makes the initial sending an entrusted communicative office.
The human-collective sense identifies a durable social body rather than an accidental audience.
Locative persistence turns the commission into sustained co-presence among that body.

changed_reading.before: Noah was sent to his people and happened to remain there for a long time.
changed_reading.after: The sending opens an embedded mission whose defining action is sustained presence inside the addressed collective.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 8, 9, 11, and 12: a thousand, the first year-term, the fifty-unit exception, and the second year-term.
baseline_models.mechanism: The duration is composed rather than rounded: an aggregate thousand is explicitly reduced by fifty. The switch between two year lexemes retains both a plain calendrical measure and a secondary sense of recurring temporal course, so the span is exact without being texturally flat.

activation_trace.role: The aggregated-thousand sense supplies the large counted total.
The direct year-and-term sense supplies the first calendrical unit.
The alternate mapped sense of a followed course keeps recurring passage faintly active beside the literal year.
The five-based numeral sense supplies the fifty-unit subtraction.
The complete-year cycle supplies the second temporal unit and closes the calculation.

changed_reading.before: The verse gives a rounded way of saying that the mission lasted about 950 years.
changed_reading.after: The verse deliberately builds 950 as a thousand less fifty and marks the subtraction with a change of year-word, foregrounding reckoned duration.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Focus words 13, 14, and 16: the taking, the flood, and the collective's concurrent condition.
baseline_models.mechanism: The flood is grammatically the taker, and its branch inventory supplies an event that surrounds what it reaches. The closing condition links that spatial capture to active misplacement and withholding of what is due, making the seizure accountable rather than merely meteorological.

activation_trace.role: The grasp-and-possession sense gives the flood the functional role of captor.
The accountability sense makes the taking answer to conduct rather than chance.
The all-around inundation sense supplies the spatial mechanism of capture.
Material misplacement supplies a concrete model for a condition out of proper order.
Withholding what is due supplies the accountable social axis of that condition.

changed_reading.before: A flood killed a population already labeled wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: An enveloping event takes the collective while wrongful displacement and withholding are their live condition, binding spatial capture to accountability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening sequence treats communal claims as material exposed to assay until truth and falsity become manifest. Against that frame, the extraordinary stay within Noah's collective becomes the duration of disclosure: persistence gives the people's orientation time to harden into an observable condition.

activation_trace.role: Sustained residence supplies the temporal chamber in which the collective remains exposed.
The assay sense frames not being left alone as being tested for what one actually is.
Repeated assay extends that process backward across earlier communities and toward Noah's people.
Disclosure to a knower makes differentiation the functional result of testing.
Truth realized in action supplies one disclosed outcome rather than a verbal claim alone.
Contradiction of truth supplies the opposite disclosed outcome.

structural_cues: 29:2-3 opens with the sequence claim, testing, and manifested differentiation before the Noah account.
The focus closes with a circumstantial description of the people, presenting their condition at seizure as the result visible after the long stay.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies assay-and-disclosure language plus extraordinary co-residence; I infer that duration functions as the medium through which communal allegiance becomes manifest. A live alternative is that the number only magnifies the messenger's endurance.

changed_reading.before: The long stay measures how patiently Noah continued an unsuccessful mission.
changed_reading.after: The long stay is also an extended communal assay: time exposes what the people become while the messenger remains among them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus places an immense slow interval directly before a taking. Elsewhere the surah names an appointed limit, rebukes attempts to accelerate punishment, and says its arrival can be sudden. Patience holds through the open interval; closure need not resemble the pace of the waiting that precedes it.

activation_trace.role: Delay and slowness supply the prolonged open interval.
The grasping sense supplies decisive closure immediately after the counted span.
A fixed temporal limit makes deferred arrival scheduled rather than absent.
Demanded acceleration supplies the human pressure to collapse the interval.
The named limit blocks haste while preserving certainty of closure.
Abrupt arrival supplies the sharp temporal edge after delay.
Self-restraint under distress supplies the posture appropriate to the long interval.

structural_cues: 29:53 places demanded haste, an appointed limit, and sudden arrival in one sequence.
In the focus, the counted residence is followed by a prefixed sequential transition into the taking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies long delay, fixed term, haste, and abrupt arrival; I infer one temporal mechanism of respite followed by non-gradual closure. The alternative is simple chronology with no deliberate contrast of temporal rates.

changed_reading.before: A 950-year mission ended when a flood later occurred.
changed_reading.after: The 950-year respite and the decisive taking form one temporal pattern: an appointed interval can be extremely long while its closure remains sudden.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next ayah opposes the plural collective taken in the focus to Noah and the ship-company extracted from danger. A vessel that cuts the water creates a traversable boundary inside an otherwise surrounding event, and the preserved vessel or episode remains an outward marker.

activation_trace.role: All-around inundation supplies the undifferentiated danger field.
Collective capture supplies one side of the separation.
Escape by separation supplies the operative logic of rescue.
A vessel cutting the water supplies the material boundary that permits passage through enclosure.
The visible-marker sense turns the preserved vessel or event into evidence beyond its immediate survivors.

structural_cues: 29:14 ends with a plural group taken; 29:15 begins by separating Noah and the vessel's companions for rescue.
The rescue object is then made a marker for wider communities, so survival has an evidentiary afterlife.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies surrounding capture, extraction, a water-cutting vessel, and a visible marker; I infer the flood functions as a selective boundary rather than indiscriminate water. The alternative is that rescue and destruction are adjacent outcomes without a shared spatial mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The flood is chiefly the instrument that destroys Noah's people.
changed_reading.after: The flood is a boundary event: it captures one collective while a separated vessel-company crosses the same enclosure and becomes its enduring sign.

context_deltas.mechanism: A later statement restricts the messenger's obligation to making the message arrive clearly. Read back into the focus, long residence is not evidence that the commission failed because the collective did not change; it is evidence that delivery was sustained while conversion and final taking remained outside the messenger's office.

activation_trace.role: The entrusted messenger role anchors the focus in communicative office.
Long co-residence makes fulfillment of that office durative rather than momentary.
The recurring messenger role generalizes the office beyond the Noah account.
Causing the message to reach its addressees supplies the stated measure of duty.
Clarification by speech or sign qualifies delivery as manifest rather than merely attempted.

structural_cues: 29:18 follows the Noah episode closely and formulates the messenger's obligation as a limit.
The focus assigns the long stay to Noah but assigns the final taking to the flood, keeping mission and outcome under different agents.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a long commission and an explicit role restriction; I infer that mission fidelity is measured by sustained clear delivery rather than recipient conversion. The alternative is that 29:18 states a general rule without retrospectively evaluating Noah's duration.

changed_reading.before: The extreme duration highlights how long Noah failed to persuade his people.
changed_reading.after: The extreme duration displays sustained fulfillment of a bounded messenger duty; the people's response and the flood's taking are not measures of failed delivery.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah's later disaster inventory repeats taking, indexes each taking to its own fault, includes drowning among several modalities, denies wrongdoing by God, and reflexively returns wrongdoing to the sufferers themselves. This expands the focus's closing condition into a causal and legal safeguard around the flood.

activation_trace.role: Accountable taking anchors the focus event in response to conduct.
Withholding from what is due supplies the focus condition that makes taking answerable rather than arbitrary.
Repeated accountable taking places the Noah event inside a wider rule of requital.
Personal fault supplies the explicit index linking each group to its outcome.
Death by submersion identifies the focus flood as one modality within the indexed series.
The repeated rights-withholding sense supports the denial that the judging agent commits the wrong.
The self-or-very-entity sense makes the final attribution reflexive: the wrong returns to its own agents.

structural_cues: 29:40 uses a distributive opening, then assigns distinct disasters to different groups under one fault-indexed rule.
Its final contrast explicitly denies wrong by God and locates wrong in the sufferers' own selves.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies distributive taking by fault, drowning, and reflexive wrongdoing; I infer that the focus's concurrent wrongdoing clause is causal-legal framing, not an incidental epithet. The alternative is that 29:40 summarizes separate histories without specifying the syntax of 29:14.

changed_reading.before: The people are called wrongdoers to justify a flood already narrated.
changed_reading.after: Their active wrongdoing is the event's allocation rule: the flood is one self-indexed mode of taking, while the text explicitly excludes arbitrary wrong by the judging agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The flood's branch inventory already makes it surrounding. Later punishment is described first as already enclosing and then as covering its objects from above and below. These echoes convert the flood from a merely large volume of water into one local instance of consequence becoming spatially inescapable.

activation_trace.role: Surrounding inundation anchors the focus in total spatial exposure.
Enclosure by overpowering ruin generalizes the focus topology beyond water.
A covering that spreads over all supplies the vertical face of inescapability.
The alternate mapped covering sense reinforces concealment beneath what descends.

structural_cues: 29:54 says the consequence is already enclosing even while it is being demanded.
29:55 completes the geometry with coverage from above and below.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies three convergent spatial images: surrounding flood, enclosing consequence, and covering from both vertical directions. I infer a recurring topology of inescapability; the live alternative is independent imagery with no intended backward activation.

changed_reading.before: The flood matters because it is an exceptionally destructive quantity of water.
changed_reading.after: The flood matters as a topology of consequence: the people's condition becomes an enclosure with no exterior available to them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the surah's end, boarding a vessel amid danger produces exclusive calling, rescue to land, and immediate return to association. That sequence miniaturizes the Noah pattern and adds a diagnostic distinction: crisis can separate and rescue bodies without producing durable inward reorientation.

activation_trace.role: The encompassing flood anchors the original sea-crisis pattern.
Mounting a conveyance initiates a repeatable embodied crisis scene.
The waterborne vessel reproduces the material setting of traversing danger.
Urgent address supplies the verbal response elicited by enclosure.
Exclusive allegiance supplies a temporary purification from competing attachments.
Escape by separation repeats the rescue logic immediately following the focus.
Restored association after landing shows that physical rescue need not become durable allegiance.

structural_cues: 29:65 orders vessel, exclusive call, rescue, landfall, and relapse as a compact cycle.
29:14-15 orders encompassing danger, taking, vessel rescue, and sign, providing the larger historical pattern.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies two vessel-and-rescue sequences; I infer that the later one replays the focus as an assay of allegiance and exposes the instability of crisis-born sincerity. The alternative is a generic sea-danger example with no specific Noahic reprise.

changed_reading.before: Noah's flood is a remote historical division between destroyed wrongdoers and saved companions.
changed_reading.after: The flood also becomes a recurring diagnostic pattern: enclosure may elicit exclusive appeal and permit rescue, yet rescue alone does not secure lasting reform.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the adjacent moral burden vocabulary as load-bearing imagery around the flood and vessel. It remains anchored in the focus taking and surrounding event and in the immediately following ship; downstream prose should present it as a sequence-level material analogy, not as the lexical definition of the focus words.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 13-14, the taking by an enclosing event, read between the preceding burden claims and the following vessel.

activation_trace.role: Capture supplies the focus-side limit on who or what is transferred.
The surrounding water supplies the material field in which carrying becomes concrete.
Assuming another's moral load supplies the false transfer claim immediately before the focus.
Actual bearing of liability reverses the promised transfer and restores ownership of the load.
Load made heavy turns liability into material pressure at the narrative threshold.
The water-cutting vessel supplies the literal carrier that follows the moral carrying dispute.

changed_reading.before: The burden verses, Noah's flood, and the ship are adjacent but independent topics.
changed_reading.after: The sequence tests transfer itself: false agents promise to carry liability, actual agents bear their own heavy loads, the flood takes a collective, and a real vessel carries only a separated rescued company.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because the thousand is plainly a numeral, not a direct statement of affection or familiarity. It remains anchored in that exact focus root, the stay among a people, and the surah's later account of mutual attachment; downstream prose should call it a root-image echo rather than an alternative translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus words 5, 6, and 8: the people, prolonged residence among them, and the thousand-root.

activation_trace.role: The secondary familiarity-and-habituation sense lets the counted span also suggest accumulated social familiarity.
The human collective supplies the social body within which familiarity could accumulate.
Residence among the group supplies the sustained contact required for habituation.
Mutual affection supplies a later model of social glue that can consolidate around false objects.
A bond maintained between parties supplies the relational structure of that glue.

changed_reading.before: The thousand contributes only numerical magnitude to the stay.
changed_reading.after: As a contained root echo, the thousand also intimates accumulated familiarity: centuries of co-presence need not loosen a collective when its mutual bonds consolidate around the wrong center.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it compares the focus flood with ordinary descending water much later in the surah. It remains anchored in the flood's water-enclosure and the packet's explicit water-to-life mechanism; downstream prose should preserve the contrast without turning the historical flood into a free allegory.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Focus word 14, the encompassing flood, reconsidered against the surah's later life-giving water.

activation_trace.role: Overwhelming surrounding water supplies the destructive face of the medium.
Plain water supplies the shared material medium for the comparison.
Earth revived through rain supplies the medium's constructive causal direction.
Loss of life or force supplies the state that the same medium reverses in the later scene.

changed_reading.before: Water in the focus is inherently an image of destruction.
changed_reading.after: Water has double agency across the surah: as enclosing flood it takes a collective fixed in wrongdoing, while as measured descent it restores life to dead earth; relation and mode, not substance alone, determine its effect.

strongest_changes: The 950-year residence became an extended assay and sustained fulfillment of a bounded messenger office, not merely a measure of failed persuasion.
The immense delay and abrupt taking became one appointed-term mechanism: respite can be long while closure remains sudden.
The flood became a selective, self-indexed boundary that captures one collective while a vessel-company is separated for rescue and evidence.
The later sea-crisis cycle reactivated the Noah event as a recurring test in which rescue does not guarantee durable reorientation.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah cues repeatedly reactivated the focus through temporal control, enclosure, accountable taking, transport, rescue, and relapse. The split time-root inventories also preserved secondary textures without forcing them into the literal arithmetic.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the switch between the two year lexemes carries deliberate temporal texture beyond exact counting.
Whether the later enclosure and above-below coverage deliberately recall the flood or simply reuse independent consequence imagery.
Whether the burden-to-vessel sequence is a designed load-bearing analogy or only suggestive adjacency.
How much interpretive weight the numeral-root's familiarity branch can bear beyond a carefully marked lexical echo.

reader_a.activated_readings_md: 1. **Delay as part of the trial mechanism.** ل ب ث B001 is staying in a place and B002 is delay and slowness. The exceptional duration precedes the abrupt taking by the flood. I infer that prolonged residence supplies an extended interval for response rather than evidence that consequence will not arrive; the ayah reads the long delay as patient exposure of settled wrongdoing.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: The named term and sudden arrival in 29:53 clarify the long residence: objective delay never means indeterminacy. A fixed consequence can remain experientially sudden after an extended interval.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Long residence is assembled from repeated temporal units.** Lexical evidence: `لَبِثَ`, root `ل ب ث`, `B001` (staying in a place); `أَلْفَ`, root `ء ل ف`, `B001` (the thousand as gathered hundreds); `سَنَة`, root `س ن و`, `B008` (a year and staying a year); and `عَامًا`, root `ع و م`, `B002` (the year-cycle). Structural cue: a gathered thousand is explicitly reduced by fifty cycles, after `29:13` used additive moral weights and before `29:19` pairs beginning with repetition. Assigned role: the numerical branches turn prophetic persistence into accumulated stays rather than an undifferentiated “long time.” Abductive move: I infer that repeated cycles intensify the contrast between sustained sending and the community's sustained wrong placement. Reading change: Noah's stay reads as patient temporal accumulation whose duration exhausts any claim of hasty judgment.

2. **An enveloping event separates an entrenched society.** Lexical evidence: `أَخَذَهُم`, root `ء خ ذ`, `B002` (taking someone to account for a fault); `ٱلطُّوفَان`, root `ط و ف`, `B002` (enveloping flood or event); and `ظَالِمُون`, root `ظ ل م`, `B004` (doing something at the wrong concrete time or place). Structural cue: social staying fills the first half; total envelopment ends it, and `29:15` immediately extracts the ship-company by `ن ج و B001` (deliverance by separation). Assigned role: the flood is the enveloping separator; wrong placement names the entrenched condition taken to account. Abductive move: the packet states seizure and rescue but not that spatial enclosure mirrors social entrenchment; that analogy is my inference. Reading change: the flood is read as a discriminating spatial event after prolonged social fixation, not indiscriminate water imagery.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: - **Later surprise (`29:40`, `29:63`):** Water later appears both as drowning and as the mediator that revives dead earth. This corrects a one-note reading of the flood: water is not intrinsically punitive; in `29:14`, its enveloping role becomes judgment because of the social condition it encounters.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_channel: P2 (29:14-27) Manufactured Allegiance and Its Reversal
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A cultic object becomes powerful through service, possession, affection, and alliance, then those same relations reverse into repudiation and expulsion.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Idolatry appears less as a static object class than as a deliberately assembled social and property regime whose bonds later run backward.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Affection as an Alliance Contract
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Shared attachment to a cultic object binds parties through proximity, patronage, and a connective social compact.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: affection and mutual love `quranic:root_001634:B001/m01`; Wadd as a named idol `quranic:root_001634:B005/m01`; loving and protective alliance `quranic:root_001684:B004/m01`; legal clientage `quranic:root_001684:B005/m01`; a connective relation between parties `quranic:root_000170:B003/m01`; taking and possessing an object `quranic:root_000018:B001/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: "Affection among you" behaves like alliance infrastructure: proximity, protection, clientage, and possession gather around a shared object. Wadd's lexical identity as an idol sharpens the pun by making affection itself both bond and cultic name.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: A dispatched communication reaches its limit by becoming an intelligible, inspectable mark.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Communication is simultaneously courier-work, eloquent arrival, landmark, banner, and trained observation.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Dispatch, Carriage, and Clear Delivery
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: A sender releases a bearer, the bearer carries a consequential report, and expression reaches the intended recipient clearly.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: dispatch and release `quranic:root_000563:B001/m01`; messenger and carried message `quranic:root_000563:B002/m01`; delivery of a message `quranic:root_000151:B002/m01`; reaching an endpoint `quranic:root_000151:B001/m01`; eloquence that reaches its purpose `quranic:root_000151:B004/m01`; spoken clarification `quranic:root_000170:B005/m01`; a consequential report arriving `quranic:root_001464:B002/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The messenger is a carrier whose task is completed when the communication reaches its limit. "Clear delivery" therefore combines transport and intelligibility: the report arrives and opens its meaning rather than merely occupying the recipient's hearing.

channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_semantic_invariant: Water can encircle and destroy, support a crossing craft, preserve life on raised ground, or descend as apportioned nourishment.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.parent_surprising_reach: Destruction and sustenance share one hydrological system of enclosure, flotation, elevation, rainfall, and living yield.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.name: Encircling Flood and Worked Floating Craft
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.scene_or_process: Water surrounds the settlement while shaped timber, roughening tools, and bound floats produce a surface that can cross it.
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.active_motifs: overwhelming encircling flood `quranic:root_000957:B002/m01`; a bound raft of skins or timber `quranic:root_000957:B006/m01`; stripping and shaping a surface `quranic:root_000716:B001/m01`; woodworking or roughening tool `quranic:root_000716:B002/m01`; ship cutting the water's face `quranic:root_000716:B003/m01`; swimming or vessel-motion `quranic:root_001063:B001/m01`; a branch-float for crossing water `quranic:root_001063:B006/m01`
channel_subchannels_anchored_here.synthesis: The ship appears as a worked counter-form to encircling water: surfaces are stripped, timber is shaped, and pieces are bound into buoyancy. The same root field that names the flood also supplies the primitive raft that crosses it.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, ortak çekirdeği bir varlığı harekete geçirip göndermek ya da elde tutmayı bırakıp salmak olarak kurar. İnsan, elçi, rüzgar, yağmur ve başka güçler bu işlemin farklı nesneleridir; bunlar ayrı birer çekirdek anlam değildir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, gönderme ve serbest bırakmayı kapsar; yalnızca yavaşlık, süt veya sürü bildiren eşsesli kullanımları kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalın gönderme ve salıverme çekirdeğiyle sınırlıdır; öteki dallardaki kalıba bağlı anlamlar buraya taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanı, canlıyı, doğal gücü ya da başka bir şeyi bulunduğu yerden harekete geçirip bir yöne göndermek; kimi bağlamlarda elde tutmayı bırakıp serbestçe gitmesine izin vermektir.

facets.statement: Temel işlem, bir varlığı durduğu veya tutulduğu konumdan çıkarıp ileri yöneltmektir.
Bir kişi görev veya haber için, rüzgar ve yağmur gibi güçler de etkilerini göstermek üzere gönderilebilir.
Tutmanın karşıtı olarak kullanım, eldeki canlıyı ya da denetlenen gücü salıvermeyi anlatır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, harekete geçirip yollama çekirdeğinde birleşir; görevle gönderme, doğal güçleri yöneltme ve tutulanı serbest bırakma bu çekirdeğin kapsam içi gerçekleşmeleridir.

concept_gloss.text: bir şeyi gönderme veya serbest bırakma
concept_gloss.applicability: Dalın görevle yollama ile tutmayı bırakıp salıverme biçimlerinin ikisini de birlikte temsil eder.

error_profile.preserves: Hareket başlatma, yöneltme ve tutmayı bırakma seçeneklerini korur.

error_profile.loses: Elde tutulanı yalnızca serbest bırakma anlamını tek başına göstermez.

error_profile.loses: Görevle veya haber taşımak üzere gönderme yönünü kapsamaz.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi aynı dal içinde iki açık gönderim öğesi verir: gönderenin sözünü taşıyan kişi ve taşınan söz ya da haber. Çerçeve bu düzenli kişi-içerik ayrımını doğru biçimde korur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, haber taşıyıcısı ile taşınan iletiyi kapsar; gönderme eylemini, sürüyü veya kolay yürüyüşü kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalın dalda haber taşıyan kişi ile taşınan içeriği birlikte gösterir; özel kalıplardaki eşsesli anlamlar eklenmez.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, kolay ve zorlamasız ilerleyişi; yumuşak eklem ve bacakları; düz, salık saçı aynı akıcılık niteliği çevresinde toplar. Çerçeve, yürüyüşü tek başına bütün dal saymadan bu ortak niteliği doğru yansıtır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, harekette ve uzanışta yumuşak akıcılığı kapsar; gönderme, süt ve ardışık topluluk anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım ortak akıcılık niteliğini verir; yürüyüş, hayvan bacakları, saç ve uzun bacak anlatımları kendi sözcük veya kalıp sınırlarında ayrı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Hareketin zorlamasız, rahat ve akıcı olması ya da bir uzvun veya saçın sertçe kıvrılmadan yumuşakça uzanmasıdır.

facets.statement: Ortak nitelik, direnç ve sertlik göstermeyen rahat bir akış veya uzanıştır.
Yürüyüşte bu nitelik, hayvanı zorlamayan kolay ve akıcı ilerleyiş olarak görünür.
Bacaklar ve eklemler için yumuşaklık, saç için düz ve salık uzanma anlatılır.
Deve topluluğuna uygulandığında hızlı ya da kolayca harekete geçen sürüler kastedilebilir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar kolay yürüyüş, yumuşak eklem ve bacaklar, salık saç ve rahatça ilerleyen deve topluluklarını dirençsiz akıcılık çevresinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yürüyüş, uzuv ve saç gerçekleşmelerini tek bir fiziksel nitelik altında kapsayan kavramsal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Kolay ilerleme ile sert olmayan, salık uzanma arasındaki ortak niteliği korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir hayvanın veya topluluğun zorlanmadan ilerlemesi anlatıldığında kullanılır.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, sözcüğün temel olarak kadınlar dışındaki erkekler topluluğunu anlattığını, kadınların ancak ikincil biçimde kapsama girebildiğini ve insan dışı varlıklara aktarılabildiğini gösterir. Bu nedenle genel ve cinsiyetçe sınırsız bir topluluk adı olarak sunulmamalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Temel kapsam erkekler topluluğudur; kadınların katılımı ve insan dışına aktarım ikincil kullanımlardır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım, temel topluluk anlamını bağlı anlatımlardaki yandaş ve soy çevresi anlamından ayırır.

concept_map.definition: Temelde erkeklerden oluşan insan topluluğudur; bir erkeğin yandaş ve yakın soy çevresini de anlatabilir. Kadınların topluluğa bağlı olarak kapsanması ve sözün insan dışı varlıklara aktarılması ikincildir.

facets.statement: Temel gönderge, kadınlardan ayrı düşünülen erkekler topluluğudur.
Bir erkeğin yandaşları ile yakın soy çevresi, kadınların bağlı olarak kapsanması ve insan dışına aktarım bu çekirdeğe bağlıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynakların ortak çekirdeği erkekler topluluğudur; bir erkeğin yandaşları ve yakın soy çevresi bu kapsamda yer alır. Kadınların bağlı biçimde kapsanması ile insan dışı varlıklara aktarım ayrıca kaydedilir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Erkeklerden oluşan topluluğu ve buna bağlı yandaş ya da soy çevresini birlikte karşılayan en kısa açıklamadır.

error_profile.preserves: Erkek topluluğu çekirdeğini ve bağlı yakın çevre kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kadınların ikincil kapsanmadığı temel insan topluluğu bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Temel cinsiyet sınırını ve topluluk anlamını korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir erkeğin yandaşları ve yakın soy çevresi

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Temel kapsamı erkeklerle sınırlar; kadınları ancak bağlı biçimde içeri alır ve insan dışına aktarılabilir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aşiret, kabile ve ortak işi bulunan topluluk türlerini cinsiyet sınırı koymadan adlandırır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanlar arasındaki topluluk ve yakın çevre bağını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dalın ayırt edici yönü erkekler topluluğunu çekirdek almasıdır; komşu dal ise topluluğu aşiret, kabile veya ortak iş bağı üzerinden kurar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; erkeklerle sınırlı çekirdeği en iyi açıklayan topluluk komşusu yayımlandı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bedeni dik konuma getirme ve dik durma çekirdeğini açıkça destekler. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadet sırasındaki duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde dik kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel çekirdeğin farklı gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal fiziksel dikilme ve dik duruşla sınırlıdır; niyet, gözetim ve yerleşme anlamlarını kapsamaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Fiziksel dik duruş çekirdeği korunur; belirli duruş ve kök üzerinde kalma anlatımları ona bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir insanın ya da başka bir varlığın dik konuma gelmesi veya dik durumda bulunmasıdır. Tek seferlik ayağa kalkma, ibadetteki ayakta duruş, bitkinin kökü üzerinde kalması ve hayvanın durması bu fiziksel duruşun özel görünümleridir.

facets.statement: Canlı ya da cansız bir varlık dik konuma gelir veya dik durumda bulunur.
Tek ayağa kalkış, ibadet duruşu, kökü üzerinde dik kalan bitki ve duran hayvan fiziksel çekirdeğin bağlama özgü görünümleridir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar dikilme ve dik durma çekirdeğinde birleşir; tek bir ayağa kalkışın yanı sıra ibadet, bitki ve hayvan bağlamlarını da bu çekirdeğe bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel olarak dik konuma gelme ile o konumda bulunma aşamalarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Hem dikilme hareketini hem de ortaya çıkan dik duruşu korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bitki veya başka bir varlığın kendi temeli üzerinde dik durumda kalmasını anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Dik duruşu ve bu duruşun sürmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: bir kez ayağa kalkma; iki bölüm arasındaki ayakta duruş

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Ayağa kalkma hareketini, tek seferlik kalkışı ve ibadet, bitki ile hayvan bağlamlarını da kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Betimlenen varlığın dik ve ayakta olma niteliğini daha yalın biçimde öne çıkarır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dalın ortak alanı bir varlığın dik ve ayakta bulunmasıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal hem dik konuma geçişi hem çeşitli bağlamlardaki duruşu içerir; komşu dalın kartı yalnız dik ve ayakta olma niteliğini bildirir.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; fiziksel dik duruşla en doğrudan örtüşen aday sınır farkıyla yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قام قياما، والقومة مرة الانتصاب، والقيام في الصلاة أو الذكر، وقيام الشجر والنبت على أصله، ووقوف الدابة

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi, belirli bir işe yönelip onu üstlenme anlamındaki kararlı niyet ve girişimi destekler. Anlam yalnız zihinsel isteme değil, işe doğru yönelme ve onu üzerine alma aşamasına da bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal yalnız belirli bir işe yönelip onu üstlenme yapısında geçerlidir; fiziksel ayağa kalkma değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız bir işe yönelme ve o işi üstlenme yapısına bağlanır; yalın eyleme genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Belirli bir işe kararlılıkla yönelmek, onu üstlenmek ve yapmaya girişmektir.

facets.statement: Kişi belirli bir işe kesin niyetle yönelir, işi üstlenir ve ona girişir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, belirli bir işe yönelen kararlı niyetin o işi üstlenme ve başlatma aşamasına geçtiğini birlikte gösterir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Niyet, yönelme ve işi üstlenme bileşenlerini tek bir yapıda karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kararlı niyeti, işe yönelmeyi ve işi üstlenmeyi korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kararın yalnız düşüncede kalmayıp belirli bir işin başlatıldığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Üstlenme ve eyleme geçiş aşamalarını korur.

neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da belirli bir işi yapmaya yönelik sağlam ve kararlı niyeti içerir.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesinin baskın çekirdeği bir işi, topluluğu ya da düzeni sürekli gözetmek, korumak ve yönetmektir. Aynı ifadede bir işi üstlenmeye değinen unsur önceki niyet dalıyla örtüştüğünden, burada ancak sürekli sorumluluk ve koruma doğurduğu ölçüde kullanılmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek sürekli gözetim, koruma ve yönetimdir; salt işe girişme veya fiziksel duruş bu dala alınmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın yönetici ve koruyucu adları ile belirli işi gözetme yapıları ayrıştırılır; yetersizlik anlatımı yalnız kendi sözlük biriminde verilir.

concept_map.definition: Bir işi, topluluğu veya düzeni sorumluluk üstlenerek sürekli gözetmek, korumak, yönetmek ve işler durumda tutmaktır.

facets.statement: Sorumlu kişi ya da güç, bir işi veya topluluğu sürekli gözetir, korur ve yönetir.
Her şeyi sürekli yönetip koruma ve bir düzenin ayakta kalmasını sağlama, aynı sorumluluğun en geniş uygulamasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Ortak anlatım, bir işi veya topluluğu koruyup yönetme ve düzenini sürdürme sorumluluğudur. Bir işi üstlenme unsuru, yalnız bu kalıcı gözetim ilişkisine dönüştüğü ölçüde çekirdeğe bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Koruma, yönetme, sorumluluk ve düzeni sürdürme bileşenlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli gözetim, koruma, yönetim ve sorumluluk çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Belirli bir işin sorumluluğunu üstlenip düzenli biçimde yürütme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Sorumluluk, koruma ve süreklilik bileşenlerini korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir şeyi sürdürme, işler ve düzgün durumda tutma ile onun gereğini ve koşullarını eksiksiz yerine getirme anlamlarını destekler. İbadet ve kutsal kitap örnekleri çekirdeği tanımlamaz, bu genel yerine getirme işlemini özelleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, bir şeyi sürdürüp gereğini yerine getirmeye bağlıdır; bir yerde kalma veya fiyat belirleme değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız bir şeyi sürdürme ve onun hakkını ya da koşullarını yerine getirme yapılarına bağlı tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürdürmek, işler ve düzgün durumda tutmak ya da gereğini ve koşullarını eksiksiz yerine getirmektir.

facets.statement: Bir şey devam ettirilir, işler durumda tutulur veya kendisine düşen gerekler eksiksiz uygulanır.
İbadetin ve kutsal kitabın gereklerini uygulamak, genel yerine getirme işleminin özel bağlamıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir şeyi devam ettirme ve düzgün durumda tutma ile ona ait gerekleri eksiksiz yerine getirmeyi aynı işlem alanında birleştirir. İbadet ve kitap bu işlemin özel nesneleridir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Devam ettirme, işler halde tutma ve gerekli koşulları uygulama bileşenlerini birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Sürdürme ile hakkını ve koşullarını yerine getirme işlemlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İbadet veya kitap gibi kurallı bir alanın bütün koşullarını yerine getirme bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Koşulları ve yükümlülükleri uygulama anlamını korur.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir yerde kalma eylemini, kalınan ya da ayakta durulan yeri ve kalış zamanını destekler. Oturum ve toplanmış insanlar anlamı, yerleşme çekirdeğinden gelişmiş adlaşmış bir kullanım olarak ayrı tutulmalıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek bir yerde kalma ile bunun yeri veya süresidir; oturum ve topluluk anlamı bağımlı genişlemedir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Bir yerde kalma yapısı ile yer, zaman, oturum ve topluluk bildiren adlaşmış biçimler ayrı facetlerde tutulur.

concept_map.definition: Bir yerde kalmak ve orayı geçici ya da sürekli durulan yer edinmektir; ayak basılan veya kalınan yer ile kalış süresi de bu çekirdekten adlandırılır. Oturum ve bir araya gelmiş topluluk anlamı bunun daha uzak uzantısıdır.

facets.statement: Kişi bir yerde kalır; kalınan yer, ayak basılan yer veya kalış süresi bu ilişki üzerinden adlandırılır.
Oturum ve o oturumda bir araya gelen insanlar, yerleşme çekirdeğinden gelişen adlaşmış uzantılardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar bir yerde kalma, kalınan veya ayakta durulan yer ve kalış süresi çevresinde birleşir. Oturum ve toplanmış insanlar anlamı da bu yerleşme alanına bağlı bir uzantı olarak verilir.

concept_gloss.text: bir yerde kalma ve kalınan yer
concept_gloss.applicability: Kalış eylemi ile bu eylemin yer ve süre adlarını birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Kalışı, kalınan yeri ve buna bağlı zaman kapsamını korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin belirli bir yerde sabitlenip orada zaman geçirdiği bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Yerle ilişkiyi ve kalışın sürmesini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: ayak basılan veya kalınan yer ya da süre; oturum veya toplanmış topluluk

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kalış eylemine ek olarak ayak basılan yer, kalınan yer, kalış zamanı, oturum ve topluluk adlarını kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir yerde bekleme, oyalanma ve o yeri bırakmama eylemini daha doğrudan ve yalın anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da kişinin belirli bir yerde kalması ve oradan ayrılmaması alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kalıştan yer, zaman ve oturum adları da türetir; komşu dal ise kalma ve bekleme eylemiyle sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; eylem ile yer ve zaman adları arasındaki kapsam farkını gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الإقامة بالمكان، والمقام أو المقامة لموضع القدمين أو موضع الإقامة أو زمانها أو المجلس والجماعة المجتمعة
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو النيابة بأن يقوم شيء مقام آخر ولا يوم القيامة
branches.source_phrase_ar: أقمت بالمكان إقامة ومقاما؛ المقام موضع القدمين؛ المقام والمقامة الموضع الذي تقيم فيه (ayn;tahdhib)؛ المقامة الإقامة؛ المقامة المجلس والجماعة من الناس؛ المقام موضع القيام أو الإقامة (sihah)؛ المقام يكون مصدرا واسم مكان القيام وزمانه؛ المقامة الإقامة؛ لا مقام لكم أي لا مستقر لكم (mufradat)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi bir kişi veya şeyin başka birinin ya da başka bir şeyin yerini alması, onun adına iş görmesi ve işlevini üstlenmesi çekirdeğini doğrudan destekler. Değer kavramıyla kurulan köken açıklaması da bu yerini tutma ilişkisine dayanır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Dal, başkasının yerini ve işlevini üstlenme ilişkisidir; yalnız aynı yerde bulunmayı anlatmaz.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız birinin veya bir şeyin başkasının yerini tutması yapısına bağlıdır; yalın duruş anlamına yayılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir kişi veya şeyin başka birinin ya da başka bir şeyin yerini alması, onun adına iş görmesi veya işlevini üstlenmesidir.

facets.statement: Yeni katılımcı öncekinin yerini alır ve onun görevini ya da işlevini üstlenir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar, bir kişi ya da şeyin diğerinin yerine konması ve onun işlevini üstlenmesi çekirdeğinde birleşir; değer açıklaması da bir şeyin karşılığının onun yerini tutmasına bağlanır.

concept_gloss.applicability: Yer değiştirme ile görev veya işlev üstlenmeyi birlikte karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Yerine geçme, adına iş görme ve işlev üstlenme ilişkisini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir kişinin başka bir kişi adına görev yaptığı bağlamda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Kişisel yer değiştirme ve görev üstlenme ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: onun yerine geçti veya adına görev yaptı

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Kişilerin yanında bir şeyin başka bir şeyin yerini tutmasını ve işlevini üstlenmesini de kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Özellikle bir kişinin başka biri adına belirli bir işte görev yapmasını anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir kişinin başkasının yerinde bulunup onun adına iş görmesini içerir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal kişi dışındaki nesne ve karşılık ilişkilerine de açılır; komşu dal kişisel görevlendirme ve temsil ile sınırlıdır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; kişisel temsil ile daha geniş yerini tutma kapsamını ayıran aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه قيام شخص أو شيء مقام غيره، وأن يجعل شيء مكان شيء أو يقوم مقامه
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو مقام الإقامة بالمكان ولا ثمن السلعة نفسه
branches.source_phrase_ar: القيمة أصله الواو لأنه يقوم مقام الشيء (sihah)؛ قام فلان مقام فلان إذا ناب عنه؛ يقومان مقامهما (mufradat)؛ أصل القيمة الواو وأصله أنك تقيم هذا مكان ذاك (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kaynak ifadesi yolun düz olması, insanın doğru yolu izlemesi, nesnenin düzgünlüğü, işin yoluna girmesi ve sözün adil olması gibi kullanımları ortak bir düzgünlük, denge ve sapmama çekirdeğinde toplar.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Çekirdek fiziksel veya davranışsal düzgünlük ve dengedir; geçim dayanağı, fiyat ve bedensel duruş değildir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın düzgünlük ve denge çekirdeği tanımlanır; başka dallardaki kalıplaşmış fiyat veya geçim anlamları içeri alınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Bir yolun, nesnenin, kişinin davranışının, işin ya da sözün eğrilikten ve aşırılıktan uzak, düzgün, dengeli ve doğru olmasıdır.

facets.statement: Bir şey fiziksel, davranışsal veya yargısal olarak düz çizgisini korur, dengeli olur ve sapmaz.
Doğru yolda kalma, doğru inanç düzeni ve adil söz, düzgünlük çekirdeğinin davranış ve değer alanına uzanmasıdır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Kaynaklar fiziksel düzgünlük, dengelilik ve bir çizgiden sapmama çekirdeğini insan davranışına, işe, inanç düzenine ve söze genişletir.

concept_gloss.text: düzgünlük, denge ve doğru yoldan sapmama
concept_gloss.applicability: Fiziksel düzgünlükten davranışsal doğruluğa uzanan ortak çekirdeği eksiksiz karşılar.

error_profile.preserves: Düzgünlük, denge ve doğru çizgiyi sürdürme bileşenlerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: İnsan, davranış, söz veya işin ölçülü ve doğru olması bağlamında kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Davranışsal doğruluk ve dengeyi korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: düzgün ve dengeli olmak; doğru yoldan ayrılmamak

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Doğru yolda kalma, davranışsal doğruluk, sağlam inanç düzeni ve adil söz alanlarına uzanır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Bir şeyi düzelterek düzgün hale getirme işlemini ve beden, organ, sıcaklık gibi alanlardaki dengeyi kapsar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da eğrilik ve aşırılıktan uzak düzgünlük ile denge durumunu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal düzgünlük durumunu davranış ve doğruluk alanına genişletir; komşu dal düzeltme işlemini ve fiziksel denge örneklerini daha çok öne çıkarır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; durum, düzeltme işlemi ve davranışsal kapsam farkını gösteren aday yayımlandı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه استقامة الطريق أو الإنسان أو الأمر، والاعتدال والاستواء، والقويم والقيم والدين المستقيم وعدل الكلام
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس هو قوام المعاش ولا مجرد القيام بالبدن ولا قيمة السلعة
